name: rain-girl-combo
what: Rain Girl's two-hit combo: a downward cut, then a spinning backhand started from its last pose - Mixamo's two moves as they were changed for her. Only the changes are kept here: the moves themselves are Mixamo's, downloaded by whoever uses this (Mixamo's moves may be used, not handed on).
download: mixamo.com (free, an Adobe account) > Animations > search the name > Download: Format FBX Binary (.fbx), Skin Without Skin, Frames per Second 30, Keyframe Reduction none

steps.why: made for an axe: less forward bend, the umbrella running on from the arm on an arc, its tip trailing the hand and catching up at the hit
carried onto a child's rig the feet stood 8-15 cm in the air

steps.name: bh_from_dw
steps.why: as it comes the backhand starts from standing and the join jumps: started from the cut's last drawn pose, its own swing untouched

actions.name: downward
actions.words: a downward sword cut with what is held in the right hand: raised over the head, cut down in an arc to the lower left

actions.name: backhand
actions.words: a spinning backhand sword cut with what is held in the right hand, straight on from a downward cut

game: a press during the cut queues the backhand, which starts the moment the cut ends; the cut long and narrow ahead (155 px, 42 degrees each side, frames 4-6), the backhand short and all round (118 px, frames 4-7)
